set.body:
Objective
Run an independent adversarial acceptance slice over the production path, not a mock compiler. Preserve failed scenarios and distinctions between numerical, scope and resource evidence.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements FND-01, FND-02, FND-03, FND-08, PRED-01, NUM-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
independent audit; shared/integration predictive scenarios; mvpa-spatial and mvpa-dataset tests. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M1.07, M1.08, M1.09, M1.10, M1.E2. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Reordered/foreign grouping, duplicate keys, nested draws, missing classes, poisoned targets and unequal run sizes produce correct refusal or keyed outputs.
2. Leakage sentinels test training-only standardization and own-target-free feature maps; shared temporal origins stay visible.
3. Independent neighborhood fixtures and scattering agree for volume and surface semantics; one local failure preserves other measurements and reducer denominators.
4. Reproduce dense/operator parity and metadata-only zero-read checks on JVM and JS with frozen seeds and receipts.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt mvpaSpatialJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaSpatialJS/test
sbt mvpaDatasetJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaDatasetJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M1.11: Independently qualify predictive identity, leakage, and frame behavior
